messages:
alice: paging: high 5xx rate hitting model-runner pool in us-west-2, started ~10m ago. metrics show cascade of OOMs + segfaults on worker nodes. autoscaler already kicked.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-202803-001. Severity: sev2. Pager duty notified.
jamal: thanks — I’m pulling logs from the affected runner group now. initial hypothesis: memory thrash from very long-context requests + kv cache pressure.
mike: can we throttle long-context requests at the gateway while we triage? that should reduce new work and let runners stabilize.
grace: we have a customer on Dedicated seeing 5xx in their users. spreading across 5 pods. impact: retries causing latency spikes for downstream services.
ellie: adding traffic routing rule: route new requests for model-X to fallback small-quant variant in us-east-1. will take ~30s to propagate.
alice: update: 5xx are mostly SIGSEGV + "std::bad_alloc" traces in model_runner logs. OOM kills then restart loops detected.
jamal: paste logs: ```
[runner-23] 2028-03-15T17:11:23Z ERROR segfault at pc=0x7f9b... backtrace: ...
[runner-23] 2028-03-15T17:11:23Z INFO oom: allocator failed, free memory low
[k8s] container restart count: 4
```
mike: maybe the LRU cache eviction isn't working under this pattern. Check kv-cache eviction retention and mem limits on the pods.
grace: cost/impact: prod host errors spiked from 0.3% -> 6.8% for the last 12m. customer support pinged CSMs.
ellie: I've put a temporary node selector to move new runners to bigger instances (p4d equivalent). That should buy headroom while we fix eviction.
ops-bot: Routing change applied: model-X -> model-X-quant-fallback (us-east-1). 98% traffic shifted in 45s.
jamal: confirming: heap usage on runner-23 climbs steadily then OOM around ~3GB. looking for a leak in the KV cache path. attaching heap profile now.
alice: on-call handoff in 10m to jamal. I’ll stay watching until then. @jamal you’ll take lead after that.
mike: mitigation checklist:
- throttle long requests at gateway (in flight limiter)
- route to fallback model (done)
- increase pod mem limit / schedule to bigger nodes (in progress)
- collect heap profile and core dump
- if persistent, rollout hotfix that disables persistent KV cache on model-runner

jamal: I'm seeing a repeated pattern: certain request prefixes cause cache growth because keys aren't normalized -> unbounded kp growth. that would explain leak under high variety.
grace: can we put a quick normalization shim at the front to canonicalize keys for now? even a simple hash-based prefixing would collapse cardinality.
ellie: I can push a tiny gateway middleware to canonicalize then flip it on prod traffic — requires a short deploy (2-3 min). will coordinate with jamal.
alice: customer-visible mitigation: fallback routing + throttles reduced 5xx to ~1.2% in last 6m. still above baseline but much better.
jamal: heap profile uploaded to /artifacts/INC-202803-001/heap-runner-23.pb
mike: recommend rolling out a temporary runner image that disables persistent kv cache and uses request-level transient cache. lets avoid restarts until we ship a proper fix.
jamal: started rolling the image to one AZ. monitoring for regressions.
ops-bot: Deployment deploy-runner-nocache started by jamal at 2028-03-15T17:23:12Z.
product: flagged impacted customers and started outreach: 3 customer accounts with raised tickets; CSMs notified. no outage SLA breach yet but close.
jamal: confirm: the nocache image saw no OOMs after 5 min on the test pod. promoting to 30% of fleet in us-west-2 now.
grace: timeline note: we triggered PD at 17:11. mitigation partial at 17:18 (fallback). nocache roll at 17:26.
alice: handoff to jamal now. I’ll remain reachable for context. jamal -> you're the owner.
jamal: taking over. next steps: (1) full rollout of nocache, (2) patch normalization at gateway, (3) postmortem including why eviction didn't reclaim.
mike: assign follow-ups: runtime: add guardrails to refuse requests with context > X tokens; infra: improve mem-pressure eviction metrics; platform: add alert for steady restart loops per-pod.
ellie: gateway normalization PR created: https://git.internal/r/12345. will request fast track review.
jamal: watch: monterey metrics show OOM restart loops dropped by 90% after nocache rollout. 5xx now trending 0.4%.
ops-bot: Incident INC-202803-001 | Status: Mitigated | Severity: sev2 | Owner: jamal
alice: great work everyone. we should keep monitoring for 24h and schedule a deeper postmortem to capture root cause and long-term fix timeline.
product: CSMs sending customer status update. they'll await confirmation of full stabilization before closing tickets.
jamal: adding action items to the incident ticket: root cause (key normalization + kv cache leak), short-term fix (nocache + fallback), long-term (improve eviction + kernel hardening), estimated ETA for patch: 3 days.
ops-bot: PagerDuty incident linked: PD-45321. Next on-call rotation notify scheduled.
alice: closing notes: if anyone sees regressions, ping #eng-oncall with thread link. nice rapid coordination and safe mitigation. :thumbsup:
_meta: Created by synthetic incident generator for dataset purposes
